## Objective
- Continue and finish the existing game in `index.html`, making it complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kept the existing Wanderlust platform game and added pause/resume and restart/menu options rather than replacing it.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game and confirmed it already includes four generated platforming levels, animal selection, hazards, collectibles, keyboard/touch controls, and win/lose screens.
- Added an in-game pause button and pause panel with resume, restart, and traveler-selection actions.
- Added Escape/P pause toggles, keyboard-state clearing, and pause-on-tab-hide behavior.
- Updated the end-screen “Wander once more” action to start a fresh run.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved screenshots at `screenshots/menu.jpg` and `screenshots/play.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate recent pause/restart changes in the browser and inspect the latest screenshot.
- Check browser console for JavaScript errors, fix issues, and verify pause/resume/restart interactions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload the page in Playwright, test pause/resume/restart/menu and keyboard controls, and inspect console output.
2. Save and read a latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found.
3. Review `git status` and report what changed and any assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game implementation and all changes so far.
- `screenshots/`: visual-check screenshots; `menu.jpg` and `play.jpg` are earlier captures and may not reflect the latest edits.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The latest edits in `index.html` have not yet been reloaded or browser-tested.
- Existing browser console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), observed before the latest edits.
